# The data model

**59 tables, every column.** Generated by `npm run spec` from a database
built by running every migration — not from the migration files, because a rule
later replaced still sits in the file that created it.

| Column | Type | Null | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `run_id` _(pk)_ | TEXT | no | — |
| `document_id` _(pk)_ | TEXT | no | — |
| `read_at` | TEXT | no | — |
